test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question: Which theme encapsulates Wings India 2024, the Aviation Expo, that was inaugurated by Union Minister for Civil Aviation in January 2024?

options.text: Aviation Expo-Wings India in Amrit Kaal: Shaping the Future of Indian Civil Aviation
Aviation and Sustainable Development in the Indian Aerospace: Future possibilities in Amrit Kaal
Advancements in Aerospace: A Glimpse into India's Aviation Future in Amrit Kaal
Connecting India to the World in Amrit Kaal: Setting the Stage for India Civil Aviation @2047.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Connecting India to the World in Amrit Kaal: Setting the Stage for India Civil Aviation @2047**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Wings India 2024 is a premier aviation event aimed at showcasing advancements and growth in the Indian civil aviation sector.
 
• The theme "Connecting India to the World in Amrit Kaal: Setting the Stage for India Civil Aviation @2047" emphasizes India's aspirations to become a global aviation hub.
 
• The event focuses on creating a roadmap for the civil aviation sector's growth and development till 2047, aligning with India's 100 years of independence.
 
• Inaugurated by the Union Minister for Civil Aviation, the expo features participation from global aviation leaders, policymakers, and industry stakeholders.
 
• It includes exhibitions, conferences, and networking opportunities to discuss strategies and innovations for the future of Indian aviation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amrit Kaal**

 
 
• Amrit Kaal refers to the period leading up to India’s 100th year of independence in 2047, aimed at achieving significant milestones and transformative growth.
 
• The term was first introduced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi to outline a vision for India's development and progress.
 
 
 
• **Indian Civil Aviation Sector**
 
 
• India is one of the fastest-growing aviation markets in the world, with a significant increase in passenger traffic and aircraft fleet size.
 
• The government has launched several initiatives, such as the UDAN scheme, to enhance regional connectivity and make air travel affordable.
 
 
 
• **Wings India**
 
 
• Wings India is a biennial event organized by the Ministry of Civil Aviation and FICCI, focusing on the growth and development of the aviation sector.
 
• The event serves as a platform for stakeholders to discuss industry trends, technological advancements, and regulatory policies.
 
 
 
• **Global Aviation Leaders**
 
 
• Global aviation leaders include major airlines, aircraft manufacturers, and service providers who play a crucial role in shaping the industry’s future.
 
• Their participation in events like Wings India facilitates knowledge sharing, partnerships, and investment opportunities.
